description: A Minecraft mod that allows for better advancement progress tracking (what biomes you have traveled, cats to tame, eat all food, breed all animals, etc)

mods.name: Advanced Advancement Tracker
mods.description: Enhanced advancement progress tracking with detailed insights for biome exploration, animal taming, breeding, food consumption, and monster hunting.

releases.notes:
Bugfix release for Minecraft 1.21.1.

## Fixed
- **Advancement progress no longer leaks between worlds.** Tracking data was held in static maps that were never cleared across worlds; in singleplayer (where the game process persists between worlds) one world's progress could carry into the next. Both the server-side store and the client-side display cache are now reset on the world lifecycle boundaries.

If a world's tracker was already contaminated by a previous version, delete `saves/<world>/advancement_tracker_data.dat` (only the mod's tracker data — your world and vanilla advancements are unaffected) to reset it.
